sloka: न विषादे मनः कार्यम् विषादो दोषवत्तरः ।विषादो हन्ति पुरुषम् बालम् क्रुद्ध इव उरगः ॥४-६४-९॥
transliteration: na viṣāde manaḥ kāryam viṣādo doṣavattaraḥ ।viṣādo hanti puruṣam bālam kruddha iva uragaḥ ॥4-64-9॥

translations.english: Angada, the best among the monkeys saw the worried army despondent gazing at the ocean, and comforted the frightened troops.
